packageRules.description: This repo's own published packages are cross-referenced via plain semver ranges (not workspace:), and their interdependency versions are managed by release-please as part of this repo's own release process - not Renovate

http-client-jquery exists specifically for SAP UI5 compatibility, which still ships jQuery 3.6 - never propose 3.7+ or 4.x here (patches within 3.6.x still flow through the normal devDependency automerge rule below)
Group vitest with its coverage plugin
Keep @types/node aligned with the Node 24 runtime major
Automerge safe devDependency patch/minor updates once CI is green
Never automerge major updates - always requires manual review
